verdict.rationale: Kushki is an API-driven payments platform. Its docs list server-side flows that need no browser UI, such as direct charge without a token, authorization/capture and refunds, plus test data and a production-promotion guide, which implies non-interactive, scriptable use against a test environment. The evidence is only page titles, though, with nothing explicit about CI or automation tooling. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI integration guide, explicit sandbox/test-mode automation docs, a machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and any hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
